force_level.label: Pressure level
force_level.high: pressed much harder than experienced participants on this task
force_level.low: had much lighter contact than experienced participants (possible loss of contact)
force_level.tip_high: Ease off and let the abrasive do the work; aim for steady, moderate pressure.
force_level.tip_low: Keep the tool in steady contact with the wood for the whole stroke.

force_variability.label: Pressure steadiness
force_variability.high: pressure rose and fell much more than for experienced participants (uneven pressure)
force_variability.tip_high: Keep the pressure constant through each stroke; slow down if you feel it changing.

force_abruptness.label: Sudden pressure changes
force_abruptness.high: pressure changed suddenly (a jab, slip or abrupt lift-off)
force_abruptness.tip_high: Start and finish each stroke gently instead of pushing in or lifting off abruptly.

torque_variability.label: Twisting steadiness
torque_variability.high: twisting force was much more uneven than for experienced participants
torque_variability.tip_high: Keep your grip and wrist angle fixed during a stroke; re-grip between strokes, not during them.

movement_speed.label: Movement speed
movement_speed.high: moved much faster than experienced participants (rushing)
movement_speed.low: moved much more slowly or paused (hesitation)
movement_speed.tip_high: Slow down and use full, controlled strokes.
movement_speed.tip_low: Keep a steady rhythm; plan the next stroke before you start it.

movement_jerk.label: Smoothness of motion
movement_jerk.high: movement was jerky, with sudden starts and stops
movement_jerk.tip_high: Move in smooth, continuous strokes; avoid sudden starts and stops.

rotation_rate.label: Turning the piece
rotation_rate.high: the piece or tool was turned much more than by experienced participants
rotation_rate.tip_high: Hold the piece steady during a stroke and turn it deliberately between strokes.
